verifications.note: 江西省发改委2013年天然气利用规划政策文件(24页PDF), p.3: "省级天然气长输管道.承接川气东送工程气源的江西省天然气管网一期工程已建成管道870公里，主要建成九江一南昌、九江-沙河、九江-景德镇、南昌-丰城、高安-新余、丰城-抚州6条干线和田南-上高支线。" — states the Jiangxi provincial gas pipeline network Phase I (870 km) is already built (已建成), naming Nanchang-Fengcheng (南昌-丰城) as one of the 6 trunk lines completed. 已建成 (built/completed, supplying downstream cities per the same document) supports 'operating' by context per the status-inference rule.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Single verified source: Jiangxi provincial DRC (发改委) natural-gas-utilization planning document (2013), reposted on qianzhan.com, explicitly names 南昌-丰城 as one of the 6 completed Phase I trunk lines and states the network is 已建成 (built). Second-source hunt: (1) the wiki page's own footnote [4] for this segment's status is https://www.zhaoqt.net/shixibaogao/328552.html — confirmed dead (DNS resolution failure live via curl with a browser UA, zero Wayback CDX captures for this URL); (2) the row's other 'already on row' candidate refs (huaon.com/channel/trend/624729.html, petrobest.com/success_info.php?cid=74) were fetched and read in full — both describe the Jiangxi network only at the province/system level and never name Nanchang-Fengcheng specifically, failing the name-the-pipeline requirement (rule 4a); (3) seed citation #6 (news.sohu.com/20081020/n260128393.shtml, 'Nanchang will have gas next year') was fetched and read — it lists Nanchang and Fengcheng only as cities on a broader planned CNG-station network, never as a named 'Nanchang-Fengcheng' route, so it does not name this segment either; (4) seed citation #12 (jndsb.jxnews.com.cn, 'Xinyu/Gao'an/Fengcheng will get piped gas') is unreachable — SSL handshake failure both with and without cert verification, HTTP 302 with an empty/unresolvable Location, zero Wayback capture; (5) session WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200); Bing and Baidu were scraped directly via curl as a fallback and returned no usable result content. No second independent source could be recovered despite this escalation ladder — tier held at medium on a single but page-verified, name-matched, regulatory-origin source.

verifications.note: Same passage as the Status verification: the document is titled/framed throughout as 江西省天然气利用规划 (Jiangxi Natural Gas Utilization Plan) and describes 南昌-丰城 as a segment of the 江西省天然气管网 (Jiangxi provincial natural-gas pipeline network), i.e. explicitly a natural-gas (天然气) line.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Same source and same second-source-hunt outcome as the Status unit above (see that entry) — a provincial NATURAL GAS pipeline planning document by construction, so Fuel=Gas is stated by the document's own subject matter. No independent second source located.

verifications.note: "...主要建成九江一南昌、九江-沙河、九江-景德镇、南昌-丰城、高安-新余、丰城-抚州6条干线..." — Nanchang-Fengcheng is explicitly listed as one of the 6 '干线' (trunk/transmission lines) of the long-distance (长输) provincial gas pipeline network, distinct from the city-level distribution networks the same document discusses separately (城市天然气基础设施). 干线 of a 长输管道 network maps to GEM's 'transmission' classification.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Same source and second-source-hunt outcome as the Status unit above. The document's own vocabulary (省级天然气长输管道 / 干线, long-distance provincial trunk line) directly supports 'transmission' as recorded. No independent second source located.
